title: NFL Black Friday preview: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers, turn to Mason Rudolph against hot Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Black Friday preview: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers, turn to Mason Rudolph against hot Broncos
sources.description: Pittsburgh brought the drama this week in the NFL. Rudolph has seen mop-up action in four games this season. He will make his first start since 2025 against Denver, a team he's never faced.
